ideas.topic: The Hidden Sound of Ancient Egyptian Temples
ideas.hook: Did you know that certain chambers in Egyptian temples were designed to make your own heartbeat sound like a drum?
ideas.why: It leverages the 'sensory/mystery' pattern seen in the popular 'only mummy you can hear' video by focusing on an immersive, visceral experience.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptians Painted Skin Colors Differently
ideas.hook: Ancient Egyptian art isn't a literal photo, it's a code—and the skin colors told you exactly what job a person held.
ideas.why: It uses the 'fact check/debunking' pattern that performs well on your channel, clarifying a common point of confusion with historical accuracy.

ideas.topic: The Engineering Feat That Built the Sphinx
ideas.hook: We've spent centuries obsessed with the Pyramids, but the real engineering miracle is actually a single block of limestone that was never moved at all.
ideas.why: It pivots off your top-performing 'Engineering Giza' content, focusing on a specific monument to satisfy the high audience demand for architectural 'how-to' explanations.
